name: Vanilla Beans
description: We offer Vanilla Beans with Premium quality (Grade A/ Grade B/ All Grade), Pure Vanilla Caviar, Vanilla Paste, Vanilla Extract, and Vanilla Powder. Our company has 2 varieties of Vanilla Beans which are Tahitensis Vanilla and Planifolia Vanilla.

items.title: Tahitensis Vanilla
items.description:
• Length: 13cm - 17cm
  • Weight: 2gr - 5gr/ bean
  • Moisture: 25% - 35%
  • Vanillin Content: 1.2% - 1.5%
  • No split and No mold
  • Gourmet!

items.title: Planifolia Vanilla
items.description:
• Length: 14cm - 22cm
  • Weight: 3gr - 6gr/ bean
  • Moisture: 25% - 35%
  • Vanillin Content: 1.5% - 2%
  • No split and No mold
  • Gourmet!

items.title: Pure Vanilla Caviar
items.description:
• Pure 100% scraped from Vanilla Beans Planifolia
  • Moisture: 20% - 23%
  • Content: 100% Vanilla Caviar

items.title: Pure Vanilla Pasta
items.description:
• Composition: Vanilla Powder + Vanilla Caviar 50%
  • Geleserit Food Grade: 30%
  • Water: 20%
  • Moisture: 25% - 35%
  • Content: 100% Vanilla Caviar

items.title: Pure Vanilla Extract
items.description:
• Base: Vanilla Beans Grade A
  • Geleserit Food Grade: 30%
  • Water: 70%
  • Moisture: 25% - 35%
  • Content: 100% Vanilla Caviar

items.title: Pure Vanilla Powder
items.description:
• Type: Organic Vanilla Beans dried
  • Composition: 100% Vanilla Beans
  • Moisture: 7% - 12%

items.title: Maturity of Green Vanilla
items.description: Vanilla beans reach maturity nine months after pollination

items.title: Scalding Process
items.description: Scalding is to soak the green pods in heated water at 70 °C for 40 to 50 seconds

items.title: Steaming Process
items.description: Cover the freshly heated pods with a blanket and place them in a wooden box for 24 to 48 hours

items.title: Sun Drying Process
items.description: This process can last up to a month, depending on the weather conditions

items.title: Shade Drying Process
items.description: Vanilla beans are dried in the shade gradually over 15 to 30 days

items.title: Wood box storing
items.description: For at least one month, to stabilize the color and increase the taste and vanilla content

items.title: Sorting & Packaging
items.description: Classify each vanilla bean according to its quality, then pack it in a vacuum

name: Indonesian Wood Pellet
description: Indonesian wood pellets are a high-quality, renewable biomass fuel made from compressed sawdust and wood waste. They are an eco-friendly alternative to fossil fuels, widely used for heating, industrial energy, and power generation. Indonesia is a leading global exporter due to its abundant sustainable raw materials and competitive pricing.

items.title: Wood Pellet I1 (Premium/Highest Grade)
items.description:
• Raw material: Pure wood (100% hardwood/mixed hardwood, without bark or contaminates)
  • Moisture content: ≤ 10%
  • Calorific value: 4.7 - 5.0 kWh/kg (16,800 - 18,000 kJ/kg)
  • Ash content: ≤ 0.7%
  • Density: ↦ 1.12 - 1.3 kg/dm³
  • Diameter: 6 mm or 8 mm (standard)
  • Sulfur content: ≤ 0.04%
  • Durability: ↦ 97.5% (minimum breakage/powder)

items.title: Wood Pellet I2 (Standard/Middle Class)
items.description:
• Raw material: Wood with minimal bark or allowed wood residue
  • Moisture content: ≤ 10%
  • Calorific value: 4.5 - 4.7 kWh/kg (16,200 - 17,000 kJ/kg)
  • Ash: ≤ 1.5%
  • Density: ↦ 1.0 kg/dm³
  • Diameter: 6 mm or 8 mm
  • Sulfur content: ≤ 0.05%
  • Durability: ↦ 96%

items.title: Wood Pellet I3 (Industrial/Low Grade)
items.description:
• Raw material: Mixture of wood, wood waste, or other biomass materials (including bark)
  • Moisture content: ≤ 12%
  • Calorific value: 4.3 - 4.5 kWh/kg (15,500 - 16,200 kJ/kg)
  • Ash: ≤ 3% (can be higher depending on the application)
  • Density: ↦ 0.6 - 1.0 kg/dm³
  • Diameter: Variable (6-10 mm)
  • Sulfur: ≤ 0.1%
  • Durability: ↦ 95%

name: Indonesian Coconut Products
description: Indonesia is one of the world's leading producers of coconut and its derivatives. SpicesIDN C.V. proudly exports high-quality coconut products derived from sustainably sourced coconuts, processed with international standards to meet global market demand.

items.title: Fresh Mature Coconut
items.description:
• Description: Naturally grown mature coconuts harvested at peak ripeness. Ideal for coconut water, oil, milk, or culinary use
  • Size: 1.2 - 1.5 kg
  • Husked or semi-husked
  • Moisture: ~13%
  • Packaging: Mesh bag or carton box
  • Shelf Life: 30-45 days

items.title: Desiccated Coconut
items.description:
• Description: Finely grated, dried, and unsweetened white coconut meat. Used in bakery, confectionery, and food processing industries
  • Grades: Fine or Medium
  • Fat content: High Fat 60-70% or Low Fat 10-12%
  • Moisture: <3%
  • Sulfur-free
  • Packaging: 25 kg PP bags
  • Shelf Life: 12 months

items.title: Virgin Coconut Oil
items.description:
• Description: Cold-pressed and 100% pure oil extracted from fresh coconut meat. Rich in antioxidants and lauric acid
  • Color: Clear to light yellow
  • FFA: <0.1%
  • Moisture: <0.1%
  • Odor: Mild fresh coconut aroma
  • Packaging: 250 ml - 1 L bottles / 18L pail / 190 kg drum
  • Shelf Life: 24 months

items.title: Coconut Milk & Cream
items.description:
• Description: Made by pressing grated coconut meat, used in cooking, baking, and beverages
  • Fat content: 17% - 24%
  • Additives: None / With stabilizers (as requested)
  • Packaging: 400 ml / 1L can or pouch
  • Shelf Life: 18-24 months

items.title: Coconut Shell Charcoal
items.description:
• Description: Made from clean and dried coconut shells. Used in BBQ, shisha, and activated carbon industries
  • Fixed carbon: >75%
  • Ash content: <4%
  • Moisture: <10%
  • Size: Customizable
  • Packaging: 20 kg PP bags or bulk

items.title: Cocopeat & Coir Fiber
items.description:

  • Coir Fiber Specifications: Length 5-25 cm, Impurities <5%, Bale weight 90-120 kg, Use Soil conditioner, hydroponics, brushes, ropes, mats
